scope: Independent review of runtime diff and affected numerical/host contract source only; no review of own local controllers.

checks.name: single_log_guard_only
checks.evidence: src/model/moe.cu:688 replaces only the old partition_mode == 1 fprintf guard. Existing partition planner, diagnostics counters, flush/forward/error logs, expert pipeline and numerical expressions are unchanged.

checks.name: explicit_phase_plumbing
checks.evidence: RunLayers -> DecoderLayerForward -> MoEForward appends a logging-only enum with kUnknown default. Only ModelDecodeStep and ModelDecodeBatchMulti mark it, with latter restricted to B == 1. Expanded RunLayers optional arguments preserve seq_id/d_seq_id/tokens_per_seq/ragged/logits_rows/request context positions.

checks.name: scheduler_and_fallback
checks.evidence: Unchanged scheduler calls ModelDecodeBatchMulti after kDecode Submit; unchanged fallback calls ModelDecodeStepSeq, which calls ModelDecodeStep. Both reach the explicit single-decode marker for this max_seq=1 MTP-off phase.

checks.name: prefill_unknown_and_batch_protection
checks.evidence: Other RunLayers callers retain kUnknown, including ModelDecodeBatch used for continuation/verification. Guard additionally requires T == 1 and no request context. Prefill T1 and long singleton tails retain records; unknown direct callers, B>1 and contradictory prefill identity cannot suppress logs.

checks.name: strict_default_and_cached_identity
checks.evidence: Parser accepts only unset/0/1; unset defaults 0. ChatServer::Start validates before tokenizer/model allocation, MoEForward rejects invalid values, one cached function logs explicit_single_decode configuration once. Phase enum does not affect partition selection.

checks.name: compute_cache_budget_unchanged
checks.evidence: Reviewed changed runtime paths contain argument plumbing/config validation/logging guard only. No src/quant or GEMM kernel changes appear in git diff; no cache budget, eviction, precision, payload or stream-operation changes were introduced.

checks.name: host_contract_source_coverage
checks.evidence: Seven new declared host contracts cover strict opt-in, default logs, explicit phase, prefill identity/tails, other batch shapes and global-off preservation; eight prior request policy cases remain.

checks.name: numerical_fixture_scope
checks.evidence: Only RunPartitionNumericalCase adds log_phase and a descriptive print. Its sole T1 invocation is the existing post-prefill decode-bypass fixture; the separate request-policy singleton helper remains unknown and keeps its context. Existing comparisons, dispatch assertions and eight request-policy cases are unchanged.

limits: Static source review is not compilation, host execution, HTTP quality, numerical or performance acceptance.
The cached getter check and phase plumbing run in every applicable MoE forward; this common overhead and removed fprintf timing must be measured by the frozen same-binary arms.
Enum validity is a caller logging contract, not a new model-stage validator; unknown callers conservatively retain old logs.
Actual quiet suppression and retained per-layer execution evidence require the planned HTTP/log audit; no claim that it explains all prior regression.
